items.title: Deliver the structural and contextual editorial repair
items.question: Can an economist follow the argument from a banking choice to an investment decision?
items.required_result: A parts-based edition, banking-language openings and transitions, contextual prose repairs, explanatory figures and preserved science.
items.conclusion: Nine-part integrated reading edition delivered; banking narrative, contextual prose repairs, six figures and comparative conclusions; preservation and layout checks pass.

items.title: Complete comparative software recommendations
items.question: Which capabilities should we adopt, integrate, port or reject?
items.required_result: Developed conclusions across 17 areas and all required language/commercial dimensions, with evidence and consequential unknowns.
items.progress: Seventeen-area comparative synthesis delivered with adopt/integrate/port/reject reasoning and commercial alternatives. Exact area-language census, unresolved candidates and matched external-package execution remain open.
items.next_action: Prioritise unresolved candidates that could change a route recommendation; use existing 102-cell evidence and corrected continuations instead of repeating inspected sources.

items.title: Synthesize language models and causal reasoning
items.question: Where does assistance improve formulation, diagrams, discovery, identification and interpretation?
items.required_result: Primary-source synthesis, meaningful baselines, failures and remedies, and discriminating experiments.
items.progress: Task-based formulation, diagram, identification, measurement and evaluation synthesis added. Gaussian proxy example establishes a decision-relevant measurement boundary; no live model benefit claimed.
items.next_action: Resolve the most decision-relevant of 31 unread originals through permitted routes; preserve 82 inspected/31 unread census until actual new inspection. A live comparison requires fixed model, permitted held-out inputs, adjudication and budget.

items.title: Synthesize and extend public-data evidence
items.question: Which available demonstrations justify spending on a prototype?
items.required_result: Comparable estimands and practitioner baselines, uncertainty and negative results, implications for the design.
items.progress: Ran 3000 matched offer replications and 6000 independently prespecified sparse-support replications. A target mismatch reverses the offer decision; pooled intervals fail under unequal variance; conservative intervals retain conditional coverage but lose precision. A frozen public-data experiment now fits UCI archived-contact predictions: unavailable duration raises later-archive AUC from 0.630 to 0.793; substantial early/late composition differences remain. No causal contact effect is claimed.
items.next_action: Extend a genuinely causal public-data comparison using an identified target and matched practitioner baseline; the UCI timing comparison is executed and must not be repeated as if new.

items.title: Explain practical library, CLI and MCP use
items.question: How would a bank economist conduct a defensible study using these tools?
items.required_result: Worked studies from data and assumptions to interpretation; reuse decisions; proposed and executed behavior distinguished.
items.progress: Four constructed cases executed through library, CLI and local MCP with identical responses, including timing failures and unsupported dependent sampling. First initialization timeout retained; bounded retry passed.
items.next_action: Complete an end-to-end financial study using an actual estimator and align remaining banking journeys and consumer-specific needs; no sibling edits or general integration acceptance.

items.title: Form the conditional investment recommendation
items.question: What should be built or reused, and what evidence would reverse the choice?
items.required_result: Alternatives, conditional costs and benefits, information value and a justified next experiment.
items.progress: Conditional proposal recommendation delivered: compare a narrowly integrated prototype with the existing estate; fund further work only on measured analytical benefit and cost. Alternatives, annual cost-benefit equation, reversal conditions and next experiment are explicit; no numerical ROI or product acceptance claimed.
items.next_action: Revisit when matched analyst-study costs and quality, vendor entitlements/prices or bank-pilot evidence can change the conditional recommendation.
items.conclusion: Conditional proposal recommendation delivered: compare a narrowly integrated prototype with the existing estate; fund further work only on measured analytical benefit and cost. Alternatives, annual cost-benefit equation, reversal conditions and next experiment are explicit; no numerical ROI or product acceptance claimed.
